vachanas.kannada:
ಆಗಿಲ್ಲದ ಸಿರಿ, ಆಯುಷ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲದ ಬದುಕು.
ಸುಖವಿಲ್ಲದ ಸಂಸಾರ.
ಎಳತಟೆಗೊಂಬ ಕಾಯದ ಸಂಗ.
ಬಳಲಿಸುವ ಜೀವಭಾವ.
ಇವರ ಕಳವಳವಳಿದಲ್ಲದೆ
ಮಳುಬಾವಿಯ ಸೋಮನ ತಿಳಿಯಬಾರದು.
vachanas.transliteration:
āgillada siri, āyuṣyavillada baduku.
sukhavillada sansāra.
eḷataṭegomba kāyada saṅga.
baḷalisuva jīvabhāva.
ivara kaḷavaḷavaḷidallade
maḷubāviya sōmana tiḷiyabāradu.
vachanas.translation:
Wealth that is not truly one's own, and a life without lasting span.
Worldly existence devoid of true happiness.
The companionship of a body that perishes in but a few days.
The soul burdened by the sense of individual existence.
Unless one is freed from the anxiety caused by these,
One cannot know the Sōma of Maḷubāvi.
